full_prompt_en: A square comic-style character illustration places a forceful, dark-haired hero in front of a white page filled with lighter pencil studies. The background is open and almost uncolored, so separate sketches around the edges remain visible through their thin warm-gray lines. A large horned creature's head occupies the upper left, while a smaller pointed-eared face peers from the upper right. Along the right middle, an animal-like head turns toward the central figure, and more loosely drawn heads and bodies appear near the lower corners. In front of these studies, the central man surges diagonally from the upper right toward the lower left. His thick black-blue hair spikes backward, echoing the movement of his bent torso. Strong brows, a squared jaw, and a tight mouth give his face a determined expression, while one eye looks sharply toward the right. He wears a faded blue sleeveless outer layer over a gray shirt with rolled sleeves, brown trousers, a dark belt, and a small red cloth at his left hip. One muscular arm projects into the left foreground; the nearer knee rises beneath his torso as the other leg drops toward the bottom edge. Dark ink contours sharpen his face, hair, and clothing folds, while softer pencil construction lines remain apparent in the surrounding studies. Subdued blue, umber, warm skin tones, and a small red accent separate the finished figure from the pale sketches without covering the white ground. Light is broad and even, with short shadow hatching beneath planes of hair, cheek, arm, and cloth rather than a realistic cast shadow. The overall composition feels energetic and exploratory, contrasting one solid, colored diagonal figure with a ring of unfinished line drawings.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形漫画风格角色插画将一位动作强劲的黑发英雄置于白纸前，周围布满更浅的铅笔习作。背景开阔，几乎没有上色，画边各处独立草图的暖灰细线因此保持可见。左上方有一只巨大的角兽头部，右上方探出一张较小的尖耳面孔。右侧中部，一个动物般的头朝向中心人物，下方角落还出现画得较松的头部与身体习作。在这些草图前，中央男子从右上向左下斜冲。他浓密的蓝黑头发向后炸开，呼应弯曲躯干的运动。浓眉、方正下颌与紧闭嘴唇赋予脸部坚定表情，一只眼睛锐利地望向右侧。他在灰衬衫外穿褪色蓝色无袖外层，袖子卷起，下身是棕裤、深色腰带，左胯有一小片红布。一条结实手臂伸向左侧前景；较近的膝盖抬到躯干下方，另一条腿落向画幅底缘。深色墨线轮廓强化他的面孔、头发与衣褶，周围习作中仍可见更柔软的铅笔结构线。低调蓝色、棕褐色、暖肤色和一点红色将完成度较高的人物与浅色草图区分开，却不遮盖白底。照明宽泛而均匀，头发、脸颊、手臂和布料的平面下方以短促排线表现阴影，而不是写实投影。整体构图充满动作与探索感，以一个坚实、着色的斜向形体对照一圈未完成的线稿。
style_prompt_en: The illustration combines assertive ink contours, energetic pencil underdrawing, and restrained blocks of color on a mostly white ground. One large diagonal mass is rendered with deep blue-black accents and modeled warm midtones; smaller surrounding forms remain pale, sketchy, and partly unresolved. Tapered lines change weight rapidly, making sharp turns and compressed folds feel lively. Short hatch marks and selective shading describe volume without smoothing away the drawn surface. A limited mix of dusty blue, warm brown, muted red, and gray gives the most developed area weight while the wide paper field keeps the arrangement breathable. Edges range from hard finished outlines to faint construction strokes. Broad even light is expressed through value modeling rather than strong environmental shadow. The overall effect is bold and kinetic, with contrast between finished density and exploratory linework driving the visual rhythm.
style_prompt_zh: 插画在大面积白底上结合坚定的墨线轮廓、富于动作感的铅笔底稿和克制的色块。一块巨大的斜向形体以深蓝黑重音和暖色中间调塑形，周围较小的形态则保持浅淡、草图化且部分未定稿。粗细迅速变化的收尖线条让急转的边缘和挤压的褶面显得活跃。短排线与选择性阴影描绘体积，却没有磨平手绘表面。灰蓝、暖棕、低调红和灰色组成有限色盘，赋予最完整区域重量，同时宽阔纸面让布局保有呼吸。边缘从坚硬的完稿勾线过渡到隐约的结构笔迹。宽泛均匀的光通过明度塑形表达，而非强烈环境投影。整体效果大胆而有动势，由完整密度与探索性线稿之间的反差推动视觉节奏。
theme_en: A dynamic comic hero surrounded by pale character sketches
theme_zh: 一位动作中的漫画英雄，四周环绕浅色角色草图
name: Joe Madureira
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
